title: M/F Remix
overview: San Diego, California, 2004. Two roommates in war time. Right in the middle of George Bush's re-election. YouTube doesn’t exist yet, but people are starting to place ads for themselves on Facebook. The iPhone will soon be on the scene and more and more people will be coming round to the reality of ‘I iPod, therefore I am’. Whatever happened to the grandchildren of ‘the Marx and Coca-Cola generation’? This isn't a remake of Masculin Feminin, but a remix.
